branch: research/r2-v4-ood-exploration (from 5bca217; PR #34 and the v3 freeze are untouched)
status_of_evidence: post-freeze EXPLORATORY development cross-validation on the v3 inner folds. The inner folds have already informed v1-v3 selections, so no v4 number is blind, independent or confirmatory. Any v4 claim is a development claim with a nested leave-one-fold-out estimate.

frozen_inputs.candidate_policy: r2-candidate-policy-v1: universe = F u H; E removed

data_rules: DPD-Small training images only, addressed through the training CSV (research_r2.data.load_training_source); the image folder also holds official-test files, which are never listed, opened or hashed
no official-test inference, metadata or labels; no external labelled datasets; pretrained weights only from the existing local pretrained_weights folder

v1 locked folds, v2 outer folds (O1, O2) and the outer-exclusion rows are not used: outer-exclusion features stay NaN-poisoned in every frozen-feature run, and fine-tuning reads only fold fitting_rows
no First Run worktree, experiment output, checkpoint or receipt is read or written; v4 outputs go to workspace/experiments/r2-compositional/v4/ only
primary_metric: mean over the 6 inner folds of H_bal (harmonic mean of seen Top-1 and unseen composition-macro Top-1) at leave-one-fold-out gamma (grid 0..16 step 0.25), exactly as v3
control: D1_synthComp_norm (reproduced; v3 values must match within 1e-5 before any v4 row is scored)

gate.in_sample: same as v3: >= +1.0 pp mean primary over the 6 folds, >= 5 of 6 folds better, AUSUC not lower, healthy shortcut <= +5 pp
gate.nested: the nested leave-one-fold-out estimate (scripts/r2_select.py logic, rerunning every mechanical choice inside the 5 remaining folds, including 'best of J1-J3' parents) must also reach >= +1.0 pp and >= 5 of 6 held folds
gate.stochastic_rows: rows with training randomness (stage J, I4, I5) are screened at seed 0; a seed-0 pass triggers seeds 1 and 2, and the gate is re-applied to the 3-seed mean; every seed's result is reported
gate.uncertainty: paired composition-level bootstrap of the H_bal difference to D1 (resampling held-out compositions within folds, 2,000 resamples, seed 0), reported with every gate row

stages.K_new_backbones: NOT declared: requires downloads and package installs, which need the owner's authorisation (see docs/R2_v4_Plan.md section 5)

multiplicity: about 20 declared rows; at the v3 noise level (seed spread of D2 about +/-0.4 pp) a single +1 pp pass in 20 tries is plausible by chance, hence the nested and 3-seed requirements. Report every row, including failures and aborted runs.

integrity.tolerance: 1e-5 for every reproduction check (fixed; never widened)
integrity.packets: every saved score packet is validated against research_r2.packets.fold_contract and pinned in a new v4 registry; v1-v3 packets are never modified
integrity.receipts: selection receipts via scripts/r2_select.py with --registry (v4 registry); --allow-unregistered only for runs labelled exploratory
integrity.failures: a failed or aborted run is recorded in its stage's summaries.jsonl with status, error and wall time, never deleted

resource_limits.gpu: one GPU job at a time on the RTX 4060 Laptop (8 GiB, about 5.8 GiB free with the display); peak allocation <= 6.0 GiB
resource_limits.disk: <= 60 GiB for all v4 outputs; no model checkpoints kept after features are extracted (unless a row passes its gate)
resource_limits.wall: a stage J row is aborted and recorded if it exceeds 2x its estimate

matrix_sha256: filled by the declaring commit (see research_r2_v4/DECLARATION.json)
